@graph.name: Land cover at 10 m inside Kras (SI3000276), CLC+ Backbone 2018 and 2021
@graph.description: Pixel counts and area of each CLC+ Backbone class inside the Natura 2000 site SI3000276, for 2018 and 2021, computed by the EEA image services over the site boundary (EPSG:3035, 10 m pixels). Site area 48,042.4 ha. The two years are separate classifications: their difference mixes real change with differences in classification and is not presented as change. Accuracy per year: see each year's CLMS validation report (cited). CLC+ classes are land cover, not Annex I habitat types.
@graph.creditText: BMD Single Access Point prototype (A. Fouilloux), whose data builders are reused here (vendored in pipeline/builders/); FAIR2Adapt (FAIR to Adapt to Climate Change), European Commission grant 101188256, which funded the prototype code
@graph.conditionsOfAccess: Copernicus Land Monitoring Service data: free of charge, for any purpose (CLMS).
